verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing is a subscription and invoicing platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so plugging in external MCP servers for it to consume is a category error for this product type. The only MCP evidence is Stripe's own MCP server (stripe-billing-docs-18, probe-4), which is the server role. Server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
